ios.desc:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless 4K webcam for OBS, Streamlabs and any streaming app. Add one link as a Browser Source and go live over Wi-Fi: no cables, drivers or extra software.

Livestreaming on Twitch or YouTube and ready for the face reveal? Looking for a webcam, but they're all either expensive or just terrible quality?

Since you have an iPhone, why not simply use its amazing camera?

With StreamCam, you can! Open the app, copy the link, paste it into OBS and you're live. No extra hardware, no drivers, and it doesn't even need to be plugged in.

STREAMING
- Your picture reaches your stream in the blink of an eye, right over your Wi-Fi
- Works with OBS Studio, Streamlabs and anything that takes a browser source, on Mac, Windows and Linux
- Keep an eye on your bitrate live while you stream
- Have another iPhone or iPad lying around? Use it too for an extra camera angle

CAMERA
- Flip between your front and back cameras whenever you like
- Let white balance, exposure and focus take care of themselves, or set them yourself
- Hold it in landscape or portrait, the picture follows along

APPLE WATCH
- Start and stop your stream right from your wrist
- See how your stream is doing and how long you've been live
- Feel a tap when something goes wrong, and keep an eye on it from your watch face

STREAMCAM PRO
- Go all the way up to 4K and 120 fps (free streams in 720p at 30 fps)
- Full picture quality, for when every detail counts
- Fine-tune the encoder: H.264 or HEVC, keyframes, rate control

AND ALSO
- No watermarks and no time limits, even on the free version
- No ads, no accounts: open the app and start streaming
- Looks great in both Light and Dark Mode, on iPhone and iPad
